name: linear-deploy-integration
description: Connect deployment evidence to Linear work without granting the deploy pipeline broad issue-edit authority. Use when linking releases, commits, pull requests, or rollback receipts to Linear issues. Trigger with "link deploys to Linear", "record Linear release evidence", or "update Linear after deployment".

findings.excerpt: Use `Read`, `Glob`, and `Grep` to inspect code, configuration, and evidence. Use `WebFetch` only for current first-party Linear documentation and package metada
